summary: Accessible cancellation and safer interruption of privacy/destructive confirmation gestures.

changes.title: Screen-reader Cancel for confirmation slides
changes.detail: Privacy and destructive slide confirmations now provide an explicit accessibility Dismiss action alongside the existing Confirm action. Touch-exploration instructions describe those available actions instead of only demanding a drag gesture.

changes.title: Cancelled animations cannot confirm old actions
changes.detail: If a protected confirmation is interrupted by editor switching, dismissal or another overlay, cancellation cannot trigger an old approval callback. Interrupted gestures remain non-destructive.

changes.title: Keyboard identity and data preserved
changes.detail: Keeps the existing v1.0.197 typing/selection behavior, encrypted learned data, transcript recovery, offline voice hotfix, model storage, application ID and original signing certificate. No new permissions or cloud services.
